sloka: श्रुत्वा दधिमुखस्येदं वचनं वानरर्षभाः ।पुनर्वीरा मधुवनं तेनैव सहसा ययुः ।। ५.६२.२० ।।।।
transliteration: śrutvā dadhimukhasyedaṁ vacanaṁ vānararṣabhāḥ ।punarvīrā madhuvanaṁ tenaiva sahasā yayuḥ ।। 5.62.20 ।।।।

translations.english: "The heroes, bulls among vanaras, heard Dadhimukha and quickly entered Madhuvanam along with him.
